lessons.title: Practice TypeScript Static Typing
lessons.description: TypeScript adds explicit type annotations on top of JavaScript's string, number, and boolean primitives. Implement the exported formatGreeting(name: string, isDeveloper: boolean): string so it returns 'Hello <name>' and appends ' (Dev)' only when isDeveloper is true. Tests check both branches.

tests.name: test_format_greeting
tests.unittest_code:
if (solution.formatGreeting('Alice', true) !== 'Hello Alice (Dev)') throw new Error('Dev greeting failed');
if (solution.formatGreeting('Bob', false) !== 'Hello Bob') throw new Error('Plain greeting failed');

lessons.title: Practice Primitives and typeof Guards
lessons.description: JavaScript's three most common primitives are string, number, and boolean (always lowercase in TypeScript). Implement the exported describeValue(value: string | number | boolean): string that uses a typeof type guard to return exactly 'string', 'number', or 'boolean'. The test checks all three primitives.
